scope: One read-only precommit gate for v10 delta after 5473be8; local commit, not release gate
conditions: Connected Xiaomi, independent focuscheck v10 APK, whitelist only QQ/WeChat, awake/unlocked device, accessibility/popup/usage access retained and user-set unrestricted battery policy

independent_checks.post_build_doc_delta: Only documented OEM freeze/battery-policy guidance; declared before/after hashes match
independent_checks.privacy_revision: Original report/timeline/index hashes verified in private backup; measured cases and outcomes unchanged
independent_checks.kernel_control: Frozen 1 and stopped timer before policy change; frozen 0, progressing timer and repeated returns after same-APK change
independent_checks.resume_control: Same session identity, paused revision 2 -> running revision 3, actual foreground cases passed
independent_checks.staged_payload_safety: No APK, database, secrets, dependency locks or version changes staged

limitations: No full Flutter suite, analyze, backend or standard debug rerun in v10; relevant tests/profile build are actual new runs
No cross-device, long-term deep-sleep, formal signed upgrade or earlier notification action-row acceptance
source_head denotes baseline; actual working-tree source is bound by per-file hashes and verified on commit
No push, tag, release or production deployment
verification_index_boundary: This gate is added after verification.json and is intentionally excluded from its file hash index.
